# Kimi current-release metadata

Public metadata captured on 2026-11-14 reproduces a stale standalone latest
pointer (2.5.3) while npm and GitHub identify 2.6.2. `current.json` contains
response projections and the SHA-256 of each full response, not purported full
npm/GitHub bodies. URLs identify the original independent sources.

`manifest-2.6.2.json` preserves the exact official CDN manifest bytes retained
by the independent g31e0 qualification. Its hash is
`1445fe2a48cd895f863910a3448f0ac4495cc3e93aec290c66dfaf832393f896`.
It is not the separately serialized GitHub release-asset manifest. Compressed
asset digests must not be substituted for the uncompressed standalone image.
All other versions/malformed metadata in controls are synthetic variations.
